tense: past tense for assessment observations (for example, 'The assessment observed'); present tense for report-purpose statements ('This report summarizes')
sentence_style: short declarative sentences in plain formal prose, one or two sentences per observation, with no first-person pronouns
formatting_conventions: H1 report title followed by H2 domain sections in the order: Identity Security, Device Security
H3 metric subsections under each H2 section (MFA Coverage, Managed Device Count)
Each metric subsection holds a two-column Markdown table with header 'Metric | Value'
Percentages are written with a percent sign (for example, 90%); counts are written as plain integers
banned_patterns: first-person pronouns (explicit workflow requirement: voice is third-person)
internal classification labels (explicit workflow requirement; see style-profile schema description)
